references.text: God promises to deliver Israel from Egypt with an outstretched arm and mighty acts of judgment, using the same language as in Deuteronomy 4:34
Describes the signs and wonders God performed in Egypt through Moses, which are referenced in the main verse
Refers to signs and wonders that God uses, corresponding to 'אֹתֹת וּבְמוֹפְתִים' in the main verse
A parallel text reminding Israel of the signs, wonders, strong hand, and outstretched arm they witnessed in Egypt
Repeats the formula concerning a strong hand, an outstretched arm, great fear, signs, and wonders at the deliverance from Egypt
Moses reminds the people of the signs and great wonders they saw with their own eyes in Egypt
Jeremiah refers to signs and wonders in Egypt and God's strong hand and outstretched arm
Stephen's speech describes how Moses led the people out with wonders and signs in Egypt
